rationale: AGA-2a addresses anti-TNF agent selection for induction in naïve patients; ECCO-16 defines the maintenance continuation pathway after successful anti-TNF induction — sequential phases of the same treatment algorithm.

ECCO-12 establishes anti-TNF as first-line biologic induction; AGA-2c defines biologic selection after anti-TNF failure — complementary branches of the anti-TNF treatment algorithm (success → maintenance vs. failure → switch).

ECCO-16 defines the maintenance path when anti-TNF induction succeeds; AGA-2c defines the switch path when anti-TNF fails or is no longer effective — complementary branches of the post-anti-TNF-induction treatment algorithm.

ACG-13 evaluates low-dose (2-2.4 g) versus high-dose oral 5-ASA for induction; ECCO-8 specifies ≥2 g/day as the minimum effective oral 5-ASA dose for maintenance — together they define dose-response evidence and the maintenance dosing threshold.
